people.name: Abigail
people.line: Wife of Nabal, later married David

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground.
translations.bsb: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off the donkey, fell facedown, and bowed before him.
translations.kjv: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
translations.asv: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and alighted from her ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground.
